request.style: English, deep female soul voice, warm gospel choir, upright piano, Hammond organ, smooth electric guitar, gentle drums, reverent and peaceful, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
One person holds one day above another
Another sees them all as equal
Let each be fully convinced in his mind
No one lives for himself alone

[Chorus]
If we live we live to the Lord
If we die we die to the Lord
Whether we live or die we belong to the Lord
We belong to the Lord

[Verse]
Whoever observes the day does so to the Lord
Whoever eats does so to the Lord
He gives thanks to God for his food
Whoever abstains does so to the Lord

[Chorus]
If we live we live to the Lord
If we die we die to the Lord
Whether we live or die we belong to the Lord
We belong to the Lord

[Verse]
Christ died and returned to life
That he might be Lord of the dead
And Lord of the living as well
We will all stand before the judgment seat

[Chorus]
If we live we live to the Lord
If we die we die to the Lord
Whether we live or die we belong to the Lord
We belong to the Lord

[Bridge]
Do not judge your brother in his faith
Do not look down on his path
As I live says the Lord of hosts
Every knee will bow to me

[Outro]
Every tongue will confess to God
We belong to the Lord
